candidate_evidence.quote: G207 is an oncolytic herpes simplex virus-1 (HSV) that has been successfully engineered to introduce mutations in the virus that enable it to selectively replicate in and kill cancer cells, but not normal cells.
Single dose of HSV-1 (G207) infused through catheters into region(s) of tumor defined by MRI

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients are only eligible after their first progression following prior surgery and radiotherapy

role_evidence.quote: G207 is an oncolytic herpes simplex virus-1 (HSV) that has been successfully engineered to introduce mutations in the virus that enable it to selectively replicate in and kill cancer cells, but not normal cells.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: selective replication in and killing of cancer cells plus induced anti-tumour immune response

coder_notes: Paediatric-focused trial (age 3 to <22; stdAges CHILD, ADULT, so mixed_age). Only intervention is an oncolytic virus plus a single 5 Gy radiation dose (radiation not listed as agent). Tumour-tissue survey of checkpoint proteins and immune markers is exploratory and not linked to a pharmacological candidate; no specific molecular biomarker named.
